(2) ARENA: joined room with 2 players ('iter815-enhancements-1 · 2 players'), Connected state green, HP=100, mute button accessibilityLabel toggles Mute sound ↔ Unmute sound on each click, arena invite button label toggles Invite → 'Invite link copied' after click, Enter opens fps-arena-chat-input (after blurring focused button), typed 'gg from admin' + Enter sends and shows in feed as 'Streaker: gg from admin', Tab-hold shows fps-arena-scoreboard with both players and K/D, Tab-release hides it. (4) LEAVE: fps-arena-leave-button returned to lobby. NOT OBSERVED IN LIVE E2E: streak banner ('DOUBLE KILL') — reason: streak resets on death; test flow got 1 kill then died before scoring 2nd kill. Streak logic is verified via code (STREAK_MILESTONES map + kill broadcast includes {streak, milestone} in games_station.py L294-309) and the backend milestone contract is asserted in the added test_killstreak_milestone_double_kill (skipped in this env due to free-user daily quota after several test iterations). Theme toggle for lobby: no theme-toggle testid inside the FPS Game page (theme-toggle lives in AppShell nav which is not exposed on this route in the test viewport); default dark theme rendered with proper contrast in screenshots.

minor.issue: Free user hits daily_gameplay_limit=18 quickly during automated multi-iteration testing; blocks bot join and any 2-client backend tests until midnight or manual mongo reset. Consider a TEST-only bypass flag on the free E2E fixture, or use admin token for bot in future tests. Non-critical (business rule working as designed).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking a control button (e.g. arena invite), keyboard focus stays on the button so subsequent 'Enter' keypress re-triggers the button instead of opening chat. Not a functional bug — clicking canvas or blurring restores expected behavior — but users who click Invite then press Enter to chat will be surprised. Suggest auto-blur() the button after click, or make chat listener capture 'Enter' even when a button is focused inside the arena.

issues: Lobby renders in v2 dark theme; contrast is good and no i18n key leaks (all fpsGame.* strings resolved). Theme toggle is not exposed in-page — only in AppShell nav. Verified visually against dark screenshots; light-theme lobby was not captured because AppShell theme-toggle-light/-dark testids were not reachable from within /features/fps-game viewport during automation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose theme-toggle testid inside /features/fps-game (or ensure AppShell nav is visible on this route) so future automation can verify light-theme rendering per review request. Manual QA can confirm via nav-bar toggle.
OPTIONAL: after clicking an in-arena control button (invite/mute/leave), auto-blur() so 'Enter' opens chat instead of re-invoking the button (minor UX polish).
OPTIONAL: add a TEST_ONLY_UNLIMITED_PLAYS env flag or seed script to reset daily_plays for the free user to avoid quota blocking bot-based E2E across many test iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: handle_fps_ws chat handler (games_station.py L424-432): strips + caps text at 200 chars and broadcasts to whole room — correct. Consider basic rate-limit per user to prevent chat spam floods (MVP-safe as-is).

STREAK_MILESTONES = {2: 'double_kill', 3: 'killing_spree', 5: 'rampage', 7: 'unstoppable'} in games_station.py L42 and _handle_kill L294 emits milestone on the exact streak match — non-milestone streaks emit milestone=None. Frontend FpsArena will need to translate labels for i18n compliance (currently 'DOUBLE KILL' uppercase text — confirm i18n keys exist for other locales).

FpsArena.tsx L349-352: Enter keydown flips chatOpen only when chatOpenRef is false — but the listener is document-level and fires even when focus is inside another control (e.g. after clicking arena buttons). See integration_issues note above.

FpsGameHub.tsx L58: navigator.clipboard?.writeText is optional-chained but not awaited; browsers where clipboard requires user gesture and permission may silently fail. Current UI still shows 'copied' toast regardless — consider showing a distinct 'copy failed, please copy manually' state on rejection.
fps_bot.py hardcodes free-user email/password and BASE URL — flagged in iter813 too. Acceptable for internal test tooling but keep out of any deploy artifact.
